title: Olympiad Training
source_topic: ICPC / The 2016 ACM - Asia Nha Trang Regional Contest
statement: A coach must teach M topics to a group of K students chosen from N candidates; teaching one topic to a group costs the largest of its members' individual times for that topic, and the group's cost is the sum over all topics. For each query value of K the task is the minimum possible total, with N at most 20 and M up to 10,000.
